描述_EN: the porcelain is heavily moulded, the joins form the mould being visible, glazed with a bluish-white glaze and decorated in red, black, pink, green, blue, yellow and white enamels. the child has a central topknot of hair and a shaved head, in the style of children's haircuts in china in the past, and wears a diaper with lotus blooms on white scrollwork with yellow ground. a bracelet round each wrist was formerly gilded: most of the gold has now rubbed off. round each ankle is a similar band in yellow enamel, and the base is decorated with lotus on white scrollwork with pink ground. figure of a child, standing holding a vase containing a single lotus flower and leaf: the combination of child and flower suggesting the association of summer, fruitfulness and fertility.
描述_ZN: 瓷器上有大量的模具，模具的接合处清晰可见，釉面为蓝白色，装饰有红色、黑色、粉红色、绿色、蓝色、黄色和白色珐琅。 孩子有一个中央的发髻，剃着头，是过去中国儿童发型的风格，穿着尿布，上面有白色卷轴黄地的莲花图案。 每个手腕上都有一个手镯，以前是镀金的：现在大部分的金子已经被磨掉了。 每只脚踝上都有一个类似的黄色珐琅带，底座上有白色卷轴和粉色地的莲花装饰。 一个孩子的形象，站着拿着装着一朵莲花和叶子的花瓶：孩子和花的组合暗示着夏天、果实和生育的关联。
